parts.html: The K-12 kitchen model combines warm beige tones, natural-looking wood textures, and clean contemporary lines to create an inviting and functional kitchen interior.
Its L-shaped configuration provides an efficient furniture arrangement, making the model suitable for modern apartments, residential studios, and private homes.

The coordinated beige and wood-effect finish introduces visual warmth while maintaining the understated character of contemporary kitchen design. This combination complements light walls, natural stone, decorative plaster, wood flooring, and neutral interior materials.

A distinctive feature of the K-12 model is the combination of two cabinet front materials. The upper cabinets feature foil-wrapped fronts, while the lower cabinets are manufactured using laminated particleboard.
The wood-effect decor connects both materials within a cohesive furniture composition, creating a consistent appearance across the entire kitchen.
The L-shaped layout makes efficient use of two adjoining walls, providing organized working surfaces, integrated appliance placement, and practical cabinet storage.
Without a separate kitchen island, the model preserves valuable floor space and allows greater flexibility when planning the dining area and circulation routes.
A chipboard-based countertop provides a functional work surface for everyday food preparation, while the main cabinet construction uses 18 mm laminated particleboard.

For comfortable everyday operation, the kitchen includes Hettich soft-close hinges and concealed Muller drawer runners. These components support smooth cabinet movement and convenient access to kitchen essentials.
Cabinet handles are included in the configuration. Lift mechanisms and pull-out cargo storage are not part of the standard model.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for apartments and private residences in Bratislava and Vienna.
The K-12 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, architectural features, appliance specifications, and storage requirements.
Our services include personalized kitchen planning, material selection, cabinet manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
Additional equipment, including kitchen sinks, built-in appliances, extractor hoods, and plumbing fixtures, can be selected according to the client's requirements.
Order your K-12 kitchen from DUMSKAYA DESIGN and create a contemporary interior combining warm beige tones, natural wood-effect textures, and practical everyday functionality.
